stage: Standard executable-continuation rollout after V34 conditional diagnosis
reason: The four fixed reference states support different cheap controls at different public histories. This motivates testing one executable standard improvement policy against every fixed cheap control; per-state availability of a correct cheap action is not policy-level dominance.
frozen_cohort: All 72 selected roots, public_messages arm, identical model, source endpoints, MCT, menus and real message stream.
trigger: At any actually reached onboard or platform decision, compare the two legal current actions under the identical public history. Only a disagreement invokes conditional rollout. No recorded realized loss or future receipt is used by the trigger.
seed_rule: 34050 + 1000*root_index + gate_call_index, starting gate_call_index at zero. No retry or refinement after observing the estimate.
simulation: Original current-snapshot conditional physical trip chains; one draw per physical trip per world. Both current actions share the same world bank. Subsequent control is combined_rolling with new local observations and the frozen received-message snapshot. Future archived messages are not supplied to hypothetical futures.
decision: Let D be alternative-action loss minus combined-action loss. Retain every world; unresolved action losses lie in [0,deadline-current_clock]. Select the alternative only if the upper endpoint of the complete-bank empirical mean-D interval is strictly negative. Otherwise retain combined, including exact ties and overlapping intervals.
uncertainty: This finite-bank missing-outcome interval is not a population regret certificate. Paired Monte Carlo standard errors and unresolved counts are reported separately.
physical_evaluation: The chosen current action is executed in the same held-out-from-fit actual root; later real decisions again receive their legitimate messages and may invoke the same rule. All 72 roots, wins and harms are retained.
timing: Entire cold process CPU and wall, including both cheap scores, snapshot reconstruction, conditional laws, sampling, all action continuations and actual control, are charged. The quality replay remains logical-clock; no real-time deadline feasibility is inferred.
attribution: This is standard disagreement-triggered rollout with executable continuation, a strengthened baseline. A gain can reveal a useful approximation defect but does not itself establish a new OR algorithm.
comparison: Compare to each of the six original public-message controllers, not to a hindsight per-root oracle. Do not overwrite original results or the preceding four-state reference budget.
